name: @mlightcad/cad-agent-plugin
description: Empty shim package. The real @mlightcad/cad-agent-plugin is an optional peer dep of @mlightcad/cad-viewer that is not installed in this project. This shim exists only so Vite's __vite-optional-peer-dep protocol can resolve the '.css' subpath import that Vite 8.2.1 fails to convert into a throw-on-call CJS stub (unlike /register subpaths).
